agent_output:
Here are the key policies and information summarized for your new support lead:

### Escalation Policy:
Tickets marked urgent must be escalated to the on-call manager within 1 hour.

### Discount Policy:
Discounts above 20% require manager approval before they can be applied.

### Office Holiday Schedule:
The office is closed December 24-26 and January 1. No deliveries are scheduled on these days.

### Data Retention Policy:
Customer records are deleted 24 months after account closure.

### On-Call Manager Rota:
This week's on-call manager is Sam Rivera.

Ticket TCK-001 has been created to summarize this information for your new support lead. If you need any further details or assistance, feel free to ask!
